output.summary: Across every inflation item the evidence points in a hawkish direction: the deterministic pre-read shows the 12-month anchor running about a full percentage point above the 2.0 goal, with the nowcast gap even wider and 3m/6m momentum elevated; the SEP raised the 2026 PCE and core PCE medians above the prior round; and both July and September statements describe inflation as "elevated" relative to the 2 percent goal. Nothing in the inflation evidence argues for a cut. On net inflation leans hawkish for the 2026-10-28 meeting.

output.summary: Inflation evidence leans hawkish. The only offsetting note is mixed momentum (3m 2.046 near goal vs 6m 2.744), which tempers the strength. Net tilt is moderately hawkish at +6 bp.
